routing.instructions: Route this HR exception to the desk that should handle it. Choose exactly one desk. Rule: if the request shows at least two circumvention warning signs (no supporting documents, an employment shorter than 30 days, or an amount over USD 18,500), route to ethics review regardless of request type.

criteria.leave_desk: Leave requests: sabbaticals, extensions, carry-overs, blackout periods.
criteria.benefits_desk: Benefits: reimbursements, enrolments, stipends, treatment top-ups.
criteria.payroll_desk: Pay: overtime, retroactive raises, reimbursements, allowances.
criteria.conduct_review: Conduct matters: conflicts of interest, gifts, duplicated claims.
criteria.ethics_review: Requests with repeated circumvention warning signs.

policy_circumvention_review.instructions: Should this request be flagged for ethics review before any exception is granted? Answer yes only when at least two warning signs appear: no supporting documents, an employment started within 30 days of the request, or an amount over USD 18,500.

urgency.instructions: How urgently must this exception be worked? critical: a final salary payment is blocked. urgent: a waiting period, an open window or a blackout period is about to decide the outcome. priority: payroll matters or an amount over USD 8,800. routine: everything else.

exception_eligibility.instructions: Is this exception within policy? Rules: the request must have first been raised during employment (a request first raised before the employment started is outside the window). A request raised within 2 days of joining needs manual review. The wellness stipend covers listed classes only - non-listed classes are out of scope on Basic and Standard tiers. Otherwise the request is within policy.

criteria.within_policy: Raised during employment, no scope exclusion applies.
criteria.review_required_new_starter: Raised within 2 days of joining; review first.

exception_band.instructions: After the administrative fee is applied, which band does the approved amount fall into? Fees: leave USD 0, benefits USD 50, payroll USD 25, conduct USD 0. If the request is outside policy or is held for ethics review, nothing is payable yet (USD 0).

criteria.zero_nothing_payable: Outside policy, needs review, or held for ethics review.
criteria.over_15000: Payable over USD 15,000 after the fee.

external_party_involved.instructions: Is an external party identified in this request (a vendor gift to declare, or a training booked through an external provider with an invoice)? Answer yes only when a specific vendor or provider is named in the request.

expected_touches.instructions: How many HR-handler touches will this exception need? 0-1: complete, documented, low-value request (straight-through candidate). 2: one complication - missing documents, an amount over USD 8,800, or an eligibility check. 3: two complications. 4+: flagged for ethics review or three complications.
